noor.lit: Your flame is lit for today. See you tomorrow.
noor.pages1: One more page and today is lit.
noor.pagesN: {n} more pages and today is lit.
noor.oneGoal: Meet one goal to light today’s flame.
noor.readDone: Today’s pages are done. Keep going if you like.
noor.readTime: Each page counts after {t} on screen.
noor.reel: Your reel counts for today’s goal.
noor.share: Share an ayah you love with someone today.
noor.dry1: A tree is thirsty. One recitation waters it.
noor.dryN: {n} trees are thirsty. One recitation waters each.
noor.plant: Plant a seed, and it grows as you memorise.
noor.grow: Your garden is growing. Come back tomorrow to water it.
